== Description (Astrography & Planetology) ==
This system is part of the [[Sidurii Cluster]].

=== Stellar Data ===
This world orbits the K-type main sequence star, Harbane.

=== Native Lifeforms ===
Extensive native life. The following are among them:

* Carnivorous plants with vines capable of grasping slow-moving creatures which pass by, holding on to prey until the creatures die of hunger or exhaustion.
* Cat-sized hexapods with sharp teeth which act threatening to scare competitors but only attack if themselves attacked.
* Flying intimidators; small flying bat-like creatures which follow a vulture-like lifestyle but will bite viciously if cornered. Their lairs consist of hanging dried mud cocoons.
* An eel-like creature about 3 metres long which strikes from a hidden lair.
* Dog-size hexapods with large claws; similar to a spotted hyena in their habits.

== History & Background (Dossier) ==
At the dawn of the [[Third Imperium]], settlements had been established here by the [[Gumahl]]. The Imperium would later restrict the aggressive Gumahl to their home system.
